import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    M = int(next(it))
    S = int(next(it)) - 1
    T = int(next(it))
    
    while T % N != 0:
        if S < M:
            S = (S + T) % N
        else:
            S = ((S - T) % N + N) % N
        T -= 1
    
    T //= N
    
    last = [-1] * N
    cur = 0
    last[S] = cur
    
    while T > 0:
        for i in range(N - 1, 0, -1):
            if S < M:
                S = (S + i) % N
            else:
                S = ((S - i) % N + N) % N
        cur += 1
        if last[S] != -1:
            T = T % (cur - last[S])
        last[S] = cur
        T -= 1
    
    print(S + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
